source.name: Suzuka Circuit
source.widthNote: Published range; 13 m is an inferred nominal width, not a pointwise survey.
source.elevationNote: Only the figure-eight bridge is modeled vertically: 8 m estimated separation with smooth ramps. The remaining real elevation profile is not reconstructed.
source.runoffNote: Default gameplay runoff: 20 m of grass on each side, editable per zone. This deliberately differs from real-world safety areas, especially at street circuits.
source.layoutNote: Figure-eight preserved with an 8 m grade-separated bridge. Bridge height and ramp profile are engineering approximations, not a survey.
